prerequisites.requirement: Obtain explicit authorization for a named manifest and byte ceiling; this prospective record is not that authorization.
Re-resolve or permanently record the four unresolved evidence requests without substituting an unverified mirror.
Resolve per-source annotation, media, redistribution and intended-use terms; no gate may be accepted implicitly.
Run a free-space check against the proposed 25 GiB ceiling and account separately for checkpoints, resampling, feature caches and backups; the 50 GiB native RAM guard is a distinct limit.
Choose explicit immutable revisions and record independent media-byte hashes; URL-string hashes do not establish media integrity.
Execute exact-media and provenance overlap checks across the documented source lineages before sampling any asset.
Sample approximately 100 distinct source groups per selected source, stratified by task and difficulty, and review label correctness, asset availability and modality necessity.
Record QA outcomes in a new asset-QA report; do not retroactively convert this prospective manifest into an ingestion manifest.
Seek runtime registry admission separately; the registry remains quarantined, unchanged and hash-pinned.
